# T-1: Reject hook core imports

## Goal
Add hook discovery validation that rejects core-internal project imports before importing a plugin hook module while preserving plugin-internal relative imports.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R1 and AC1 are covered for rejected core-internal imports.
- R1 and AC2 are covered for allowed plugin-internal relative imports.
- The validation is shared by discovery paths that import installed hook modules.

## Implementation Notes
Implement in src/lib/plugin-registry.js near hook module discovery. Use bounded source reading and existing path normalization helpers. Do not add a general JavaScript parser dependency.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests create installed sample plugin hooks with core-internal and plugin-internal imports and assert discovery behavior.
